provenance.scope: Development diagnostics only. No model evaluation, external-validity claim, oracle, answer key, or adapter is supplied.

reading_conventions: Read batches in increasing ID order. Statements take effect when explicitly posted, unless an explicit effective time says otherwise.
A proposal, forecast or draft explicitly described as unposted does not change a balance or ownership.
Posted reversals are new transactions; they do not rewrite earlier end-of-batch states.
Both variants in a pair ask the same questions. Question categories do not imply the answer type; answer_type is authoritative.
